memory.scope: RSS is process-lifetime peak; counted arrays exclude Python, Sympy, CG workspace and temporary ufunc/generator arrays. Structural permutation arrays/operators are counted; proof records scale with actual witnesses. No complete candidate table or M-sized numerical vector is retained.

scope: Actual complete selected request including its original terminal row. A preserved unresolved terminal is not certified; only actually certified accepted-prefix decisions may be claimed.
published_interval_scope: For nonexact large graphs, independent interval intersection consistency, not full published-interval enclosure.
rss_scope: Process-lifetime high-water RSS including validation input/hash work and checker allocations; not algorithm RSS or incremental sample RSS.
